summary: TagMaster AB (publ), an application driven technology company, designs and markets advanced sensor systems and solutions based on radio, radar, vision, and wireless magnetic technology under the TagMaster, Sensys Networks, Citilog, and Quercus brand names. The company offers traffic monitoring solutions for parking, access control and security, traffic, tolling, airports, mining & ports, and fleet operations applications. It also provides rail solutions for automatic train protection (ATP); automatic vehicle location (AVL); crossroad priority request (CPR); crossroad way command (CWC); and communication based train control (CBTC) systems. In addition, the company offers RFID readers for automatic vehicle identification applications, such as gates, barriers, high speed roll up doors, gated communities, parking, road tolls, weight scales, car washes, and others; and rail products The company exports its products primarily to Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia via a global network of partners, system integrators, and distributors. TagMaster AB (publ) was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Kista, Sweden.
